experience.title: FlowLedger — Personal Financial Tracker
experience.description: Production-grade local-first personal financial tracking engine built with Go standard library net/http, Vue 3, and pure-Go SQLite WAL. Implements Pragmatic Clean Architecture with consumer-defined interfaces, deterministic integer IDR arithmetic, Idempotency-Key double-spend protection, errgroup concurrent monthly analytics, and memory-safe streaming CSV export shipped in a single embedded binary.
highlights: Strict Deterministic Integer Math: Custom AmountIDR int64 representation preventing floating-point rounding errors across SQLite, domain entities, and API payloads
Clean Architecture & Standard Library: Pure Go 1.22 net/http routing, consumer-defined repository interfaces, and WithTx closure transaction boundaries
Idempotency & Double-Posting Protection: Idempotency-Key middleware caching request hashes to prevent duplicate transaction entries on network retry
Concurrent Monthly Analytics: Parallel multi-query execution via errgroup delivering sub-50ms financial aggregations and budget status calculations
SQLite Concurrency Tuning: Configured WAL journal mode, busy timeout, and strict foreign keys preventing database lock contention
Single-Binary Asset Embedding: Vue 3 Vite build embedded directly into Go binary via go:embed for zero-dependency self-contained deployment
experience.metrics: Deterministic Integer Math · <50ms Concurrency · Single Binary (embed.FS)

highlights: Real-time Multi-Bak Monitoring: Pemantauan level sensor live bak penampungan air (Bak Utama & Bak Slawi)
Smart Pump Interlock Safety: Otomasi proteksi pompa air agar tidak menyala saat air kosong guna mengeliminasi risiko kerusakan dinamo
24-Hour Telemetry & Anomaly Logging: Grafik analitik fluktuasi debit air harian serta pencatatan log pembacaan sensor berkala
Multi-Platform Push Alerts: Sistem notifikasi otomatis langsung ke smartphone saat kapasitas air menyentuh batas kritis
experience.metrics: Real-time Telemetry · Smart Pump Interlock · Multi-Bak IoT
